Description: "Update print receipt HTML template to output delivery_charge and service_charge."
Instruction: "Include delivery_charge and service_charge rows in the print template if they are present in the order data."
ReplacementContent:
"
Amount: Rs ${parseFloat(order.subtotal).toFixed(2)}
${order.discount ? `
Discount: -${parseFloat(order.discount).toFixed(2)}
` : ''} ${order.delivery_charge ? `
Additional Charges: Rs ${parseFloat(order.delivery_charge).toFixed(2)}
` : ''} ${order.service_charge ? `
Service Charge: Rs ${parseFloat(order.service_charge).toFixed(2)}
` : ''} ${!posSettings.hideTaxOnBill ? `
${posSettings.taxName || 'GST'}: (${(posSettings.taxRate || 0).toFixed(1)}%)
CGST(${(posSettings.taxRate/2 || 0).toFixed(1)}%): ${posSettings.currency || 'Rs'} ${parseFloat(order.tax_cgst || 0).toFixed(posSettings.decimalPlaces || 2)}
SGST(${(posSettings.taxRate/2 || 0).toFixed(1)}%): ${posSettings.currency || 'Rs'} ${parseFloat(order.tax_sgst || 0).toFixed(posSettings.decimalPlaces || 2)}
` : ''}
"
